content:
Total episodes in first three seasons: \(22+22+24=68\).  
Their watch time: \(68 \times 0.5 = 34\) hours.

Seasons 4–9: \(6 \times 22 = 132\) episodes, plus season 10: \(26\) episodes, so \(158\) episodes.  
Their watch time: \(158 \times 0.75 = 118.5\) hours.

Total watch time: \(34 + 118.5 = 152.5\) hours.  
At 2 hours/day: \(152.5 / 2 = 76.25\) days.

\boxed{76.25\text{ days}}
